title: CENTCOM: formation of 12 metallic orbs skimming the ocean
summary: Jesse Michels tells of CENTCOM: formation of 12 metallic orbs skimming the ocean, about unspecified at CENTCOM area of responsibility, ocean, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Central command discusses cuboid formation of metallic orbs on USG networks.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with a man described as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, says that Central Command, the US military command responsible for a large region overseas, discussed a sighting on US government computer networks: twelve metallic orbs flying in a box-shaped formation, skimming low over the ocean. Michels links the account to a document he calls the Immaculate Constellation report, and no date or exact place is given. If true, it would mean the military had been quietly sharing reports of unknown craft among its own staff.
